newTerms.personality-gravity circuit: circuito de gravedad de la personalidad

forcedChoices.choice: la consorte y asociada; esta misma Espíritu Madre Creativo ... muy parecida
forcedChoices.reason: The glossary treats the local universe Mother Spirit as feminine (Ministra Divina, asociada creativa); the English 'consort' and 'Mother' support it.
The subject is 'esta personalidad divina' (feminine noun); the agreement follows the noun, not the Spirit's 'he'.
The English 'you' addresses the readers in general; the Spanish rules ask for plural 'ustedes'.

forcedChoices.choice: él es; él está en nosotros; nosotros estamos en él
forcedChoices.reason: Spanish must choose 'ser' or 'estar': 'he is' (existence) takes 'ser'; 'is in us' and 'are in him' (location, indwelling) take 'estar'.
The English imperative 'do not forget' addresses the readers; plural 'ustedes' per the Spanish rules.
Here 'actual' means real, not the philosophical 'actual' of the glossary; 'fuentes en acto' would add a sense the authors did not intend.

forcedChoices.choice: unión del Espíritu Séptuple / unión de la Deidad Triple
forcedChoices.reason: Spanish does not join words with hyphens as English does; the plain genitive keeps the meaning.
'qualified' means changed in quality; 'calificada' reads as 'rated' or 'skilled' in Spanish.
